# e2b_lifecycle_webhook (Data Source)

Reads an E2B sandbox lifecycle webhook by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_lifecycle_webhook" "audit" {
  id = "wh_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Lifecycle webhook ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.
- `events` (Set of String) Lifecycle event names delivered to the webhook.
- `name` (String) Lifecycle webhook name.
- `team_id` (String) E2B team ID that owns the webhook.
- `url` (String) Webhook endpoint URL.
